articles.title: Enterprise SSD Prices Run at 6.5% Last Year
articles.summary: Enterprise SSD prices rose another 5% in July and remain about 6.5 times higher than in Q3 2025. VDURA prices a 30TB TLC drive at $22,600 and argues that a mixed architecture using flash for performance-sensitive workloads and HDDs for capacity could save approximately $38.74 million over three years in a modeled 25PB AI storage deployment.

articles.title: AI was meant to simplify IT service management – new research shows it's creating bigger workloads for teams
articles.summary: SolarWinds found that 84% of respondents say AI has met or exceeded ROI expectations in ITSM, yet 52% say their overall workload has increased. Teams are saving time on ticket triage and issue detection but spending more effort maintaining integrations, validating outputs, and managing the operational overhead of AI itself.

articles.title: Layered data architecture turns enterprise data into a system of intelligence
articles.summary: Enterprise AI needs more than a vector database or lakehouse: organizations need metadata, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers that connect data with business context so agents can return trustworthy answers. The bigger challenge may be governance, as access policies also need to move into this semantic layer rather than remain scattered across individual databases.

articles.title: Adoption of WiFi 7
articles.summary: WiFi 7 adoption has reached 7.2% in the US about a year and a half after routers entered the market, with ISPs such as Charter, Comcast, Frontier, and CenturyLink driving deployment. The technology improves throughput, interference handling, device capacity, and in some cases upload speeds, while WiFi 8 and WiFi 9 are already being planned for future releases.

articles.title: The enterprise AI bottleneck is about context, not capability
articles.summary: Enterprise AI deployments are being constrained less by model capability than by the quality of organizational context available to AI systems. Atlan cofounder describes context as knowledge, expertise, and norms, and outlines Atlan's approach of mining verified context, integrating it into agent development, and learning from human-agent interaction traces.

articles.title: Comcast gives its Wi-Fi motion detector a security makeover
articles.summary: Comcast has incorporated its WiFi Motion radio-wave intrusion detection feature into Xfinity Shield, a bundle combining physical and cybersecurity protections. The feature uses stationary Xfinity equipment and compatible devices to detect disruptions in wireless signals, but its privacy assurances are qualified by terms allowing Comcast to disclose generated information in certain investigations, disputes, or court proceedings.

articles.title: Use Gemini to help manage Google Workspace for your organization
articles.summary: Google added Admin Assist directly to the Workspace Admin Console, giving super admins a Gemini side panel for troubleshooting, administrative guidance, and configuration help. Search Overviews can also synthesize Workspace documentation into answers and actionable next steps without admins bouncing between the console and support articles.

articles.title: Cerebras reimagines AI cluster design with switchless CS-4 architecture
articles.summary: Cerebras unveiled its CS-4 AI system, which can connect wafer-scale processors directly across racks without network switches, potentially reducing latency, power use and networking hardware in large AI clusters. The system still relies on Ethernet and RoCE v2 for storage, data ingestion and external connectivity, while its proprietary fabric and management stack could leave enterprises operating a separate infrastructure domain alongside existing GPU environments.

articles.title: Trust and Talent: The Real AI Lessons from a Day at the McLaren Technology Centre
articles.summary: Enterprise AI success depends as much on trust, training, and organizational readiness as on the underlying technology. Companies need to build AI fluency and governance alongside adoption, especially as many employees are already using AI without formal training.

articles.title: An IT Leader's Guide to Dreamforce 2026
articles.summary: Salesforce previews the major IT themes for Dreamforce 2026, including Headless 360, governing AI agents, securing agentic workloads, and building AI applications on top of existing enterprise data and business logic. The September 15-17 event will feature more than 1,600 sessions, with dedicated tracks covering IT, security, data, Agentforce and AI development.

articles.title: 7 lessons for IT leaders on using observability to monitor AI applications
articles.summary: Elastic shares how IT teams can use observability to track AI application quality, usage, cost, and ROI from the start.

articles.title: What is AI insurance?
articles.summary: AI insurance is an emerging collection of coverage options for liabilities that standard business, cyber, and professional policies may exclude, including hallucinations, biased decisions, copyright claims, model failures, and physical damage.
